index 7505656..441c27f 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,23 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) from the repository root:
+
+```sh
+pytest
+```
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```sh
+pytest -v                       # verbose, one line per test
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py    # a single test file
+pytest -k reconcile             # only tests matching an expression
+```
+
+If pytest is not already available, install it first:
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+```
